name: Okaa-san ni Hassha!
original_name: おかあさんにはっしゃ!
source:
Takuya and Yuuta got scolded by their mom for fooling around, as they always do.
She asked them to do some chores, which they figured they could get away with if they had a younger brother.
They knew that having sex leads to pregnancy, so they cornered their mom...

[translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ149589.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
拓也和雄太像平时一样胡闹，因此被妈妈训斥。
妈妈要求他们做家务，他们觉得要是有个弟弟，就能把这些活推给弟弟。
他们知道做爱会导致怀孕，于是把妈妈逼入了绝境……
